description: Register (or update) an OAuth issuer for this tenant: bearer JWTs with iss equal to issuer, a matching aud, verified against jwks_url, authenticate as this tenant. Up to 3 issuers per tenant; an issuer already registered by another tenant is refused issuer_already_registered.

audience.description: The JWT `aud` claim value to require.

issuer.description: The JWT `iss` claim value to match, e.g. https://issuer.example.com.

jwks_url.description: URL this host fetches the issuer's JWKS from.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.oauth.issuer_set
